WITH wks AS (
  SELECT WK_END_DT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY WK_END_DT DESC) rn
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT WK_END_DT FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY)
),
rx AS (
  SELECT p.TERR_ID, w.rn, r.TRX_QTY, r.NRX_QTY
  FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r
  JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT pr ON pr.PROD_NDC11 = r.PROD_NDC11
  JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p ON p.PRSCRBR_ME = r.PRSCRBR_ME
  JOIN wks w ON w.WK_END_DT = r.WK_END_DT
  WHERE pr.BRAND_NM = 'LACRIVIA' AND w.rn <= 26
)
SELECT t.DISTRICT_ID, t.TERR_ID, t.TERR_NM,
  SUM(IFF(rn<=13,TRX_QTY,0)) trx_l13, SUM(IFF(rn>13,TRX_QTY,0)) trx_p13,
  ROUND(SUM(IFF(rn<=13,TRX_QTY,0))/NULLIF(SUM(IFF(rn>13,TRX_QTY,0)),0)-1,3) trx_chg,
  SUM(IFF(rn<=13,NRX_QTY,0)) nrx_l13, SUM(IFF(rn>13,NRX_QTY,0)) nrx_p13,
  ROUND(SUM(IFF(rn<=13,NRX_QTY,0))/NULLIF(SUM(IFF(rn>13,NRX_QTY,0)),0)-1,3) nrx_chg,

GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2

sql.sql:
WITH wks AS (
  SELECT WK_END_DT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY WK_END_DT DESC) rn
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT WK_END_DT FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY)
),
rx AS (
  SELECT p.TERR_ID, w.rn, r.TRX_QTY, r.NRX_QTY
  FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r
  JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT pr ON pr.PROD_NDC11 = r.PROD_NDC11
  JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p ON p.PRSCRBR_ME = r.PRSCRBR_ME
  JOIN wks w ON w.WK_END_DT = r.WK_END_DT
  WHERE pr.BRAND_NM = 'LACRIVIA' AND w.rn <= 26
)
SELECT t.DISTRICT_ID, t.TERR_ID, t.TERR_NM,
  SUM(IFF(rn<=13,TRX_QTY,0)) trx_l13, SUM(IFF(rn>13,TRX_QTY,0)) trx_p13,
  ROUND(SUM(IFF(rn<=13,TRX_QTY,0))/NULLIF(SUM(IFF(rn>13,TRX_QTY,0)),0)-1,3) trx_chg,
  SUM(IFF(rn<=13,NRX_QTY,0)) nrx_l13, SUM(IFF(rn>13,NRX_QTY,0)) nrx_p13,
  ROUND(SUM(IFF(rn<=13,NRX_QTY,0))/NULLIF(SUM(IFF(rn>13,NRX_QTY,0)),0)-1,3) nrx_chg,
  SUM(IFF(rn<=6,TRX_QTY,0)) trx_last6, SUM(IFF(rn BETWEEN 8 AND 13,TRX_QTY,0)) trx_wk8_13
FROM rx JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.TERRITORY t ON t.TERR_ID = rx.TERR_ID
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH wks AS (SELECT WK_END_DT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY WK_END_DT DESC) rn FROM (SELECT DISTINCT WK_END_DT FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY))
SELECT MIN(IFF(rn<=13,WK_END_DT,NULL)) l13_start, MAX(WK_END_DT) l13_end, MIN(WK_END_DT) p13_start, MAX(IFF(rn>13,WK_END_DT,NULL)) p13_end,
 (SELECT SUM(r.TRX_QTY) FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT pr ON pr.PROD_NDC11=r.PROD_NDC11 LEFT JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p ON p.PRSCRBR_ME=r.PRSCRBR_ME JOIN wks w ON w.WK_END_DT=r.WK_END_DT WHERE pr.BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA' AND w.rn<=13 AND p.TERR_ID IS NULL) unaligned_trx_l13
FROM wks WHERE rn<=26

cypher.cypher:
MATCH (d:DecisionTrace {id: $id}) UNWIND $names AS nm
                  CALL (nm) {
                    MATCH (n) WHERE (n:Concept OR n:DataProduct OR n:Metric OR n:JoinPath OR n:Policy OR n:Report)
                      AND (toLower(n.name) = toLower(nm) OR n.id = nm)
                    RETURN n LIMIT 1
                    UNION
                    MATCH (n:Table) WHERE toUpper(n.fq_name) = toUpper(nm) OR toUpper(n.fq_name) ENDS WITH '.' + toUpper(nm)
                    RETURN n LIMIT 1 }
                  MERGE (d)-[:USED]->(n) RETURN collect(DISTINCT coalesce(n.fq_name, n.name)) AS linked
